_about: TODO-30 turn 8 (AB-13), EV-15 under the absolute ambient field (montecarlo ambient-evidence). Legacy recipe (mixedstrip / mixediso, scenario.json): Cs-137 1 Bq (661.7 keV x 0.851) and Co-60 8 Bq (1173.2 + 1332.5 keV x 0.999), separated (Cs (4,0), Co (-5,3) mm) and co-located (0,0); 662 window and Co window = +-10 % of 661.7 / 1332.5 keV; R calibrated on a Co-only run at the axis; non-cyclic decode, half extent 0.95 x rank x cell / (D/(D+S)) / 2, step 0.4 mm; 4 x 10^6 photons split by emission weight. The legacy recipe states activities (1 / 8 Bq in the config) and a photon budget but no live time; the live time implied literally is budget / emission rate = 4e6 / (1 x 0.851 + 8 x 1.998) s = 237600.2 s (66 h), used here as declared (see the turn-8 report: a premise to confirm).
